---
title: "Exploration"
subtitle: "Interactive exploration of Golden Retriever health and longevity"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Use the interactive chart below to explore the data. You can **hover** over any point to view individual dog details, **click or double-click** legend categories to isolate specific health ratings, and **drag to zoom** in on particular weight or lifespan ranges.

```{r}
#| label: interactive-plot

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

dogs <- read_csv("golden_retrievers.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(
    activity_level = factor(activity_level, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
    overall_health = factor(overall_health, levels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Excellent"))
  )

p <- dogs |> 
  slice_sample(n = 2000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = weight_lbs, 
    y = lifespan_years, 
    color = overall_health,
    text = paste0(
      "Weight: ", round(weight_lbs, 1), " lbs<br>",
      "Lifespan: ", round(lifespan_years, 1), " yrs<br>",
      "Health: ", overall_health, "<br>",
      "Activity: ", activity_level, "<br>",
      "Gender: ", gender
    )
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Interactive Explorer: Weight vs. Lifespan",
    x = "Weight (lbs)",
    y = "Life Expectancy (years)",
    color = "Overall Health"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```
